projects.title: Charging infrastructure for electric three-wheelers
projects.description: Research on charging infrastructure planning for electric three-wheelers in India, developed from Summer 2024. The Spring 2026 manuscript focuses on distributed, solar-based charging for electric autorickshaws in West Bengal.

projects.title: Machine learning for power systems planning
projects.description: Exploratory work on machine learning-enabled power systems capacity expansion planning began in Autumn 2025, with project development in Summer 2026. This work contributes to SEER — Sustainable Electricity Expansion Roadmaps, led by Rhiza Research in collaboration with the University of Washington and supported by Climate Change AI.

projects.title: Economic & environmental heterogeneity
projects.description: Developing research investigating economic and environmental heterogeneity within economic sectors in Global South countries, beginning in Winter 2026.
